N_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_personal_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_personal_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

N_dtap_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) exemption
N_dtap_exempt.short_description: Students exempted from the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) requirement.
N_dtap_exempt.long_description: Count of students with an exemption from the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) requirement. Published without an enrollment denominator, so no rate is derived. A student exempt from more than one vaccine is counted once per vaccine, so these counts do not sum to a number of exempt students. West Virginia additionally reports a grade stratum "all, permanent": the number of permanent medical exemptions in force in that year across all grades. Those rows are a standing count rather than a per-year addition, and must not be added to the kindergarten, 7th- and 12th-grade rows, which they partly duplicate.
N_dtap_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} students had a diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) exemption.

rate_dtap_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from DTaP vaccination
rate_dtap_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption from the DTaP vaccination requirement.
rate_dtap_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding an exemption of any kind from the DTaP series. This is an exemption rate, not a coverage rate: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine, so it cannot be subtracted from one to obtain coverage.
rate_dtap_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were exempt from DTaP vaccination.

or_school_immunization.name: Oregon School Immunization Coverage, K-12
or_school_immunization.organization: Oregon Health Authority, Public Health Division
or_school_immunization.description: Statewide K-12 school immunization workbook published each fall by the Oregon Health Authority (OHA). School-level rows carry the county (Agency), adjusted enrollment, and per-antigen coverage and exemption percentages; this ingest enrollment-weights the school-level rates up to the county level. OHA overwrites the workbook at a fixed URL each year, so the series is self-updating.
or_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the Oregon Health Authority; no access restrictions. County values are enrollment-weighted aggregates of school-level rates and may differ slightly from any official county figures OHA reports separately.
